content.text: I'll conduct a comprehensive SCSS responsive audit of your codebase. Let me start by exploring the directory structure and then systematically checking all SCSS files.
Let me get a complete list of all SCSS files in the audit scope.
Now let me read all the SCSS files to audit them. I'll start with pages, then components, then layouts.
Now let me read all the component files and layout files systematically.
Let me continue reading more component files and then the layout files.
Now let me read a few more remaining component files to get a comprehensive audit.
